title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Mickey Mouse?
description: Four real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Mickey Mouse, through Spain's dictator and two American presidents.
hook: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Mickey Mouse?

links.line: In 1940, Hitler met Spain's dictator, Franco, at the French border.

image.file: File:President Gerald R. Ford and Generalissimo Francisco Franco Riding in a Ceremonial Parade in Madrid, Spain - NARA - 23869171.jpg

links.line: In 1975, Franco rode through Madrid beside President Gerald Ford.
In 1976, Ronald Reagan lost the nomination to Ford, then joined him onstage.

image.file: File:President Ronald Reagan and Nancy Reagan during a trip to Orlando, Florida and a visit to Epcot Center at Disney World and a group photograph with Mickey Mouse and Minnie Mouse - DPLA - 5810c0c969617ab7f42e1b068ba08dca.jpg

links.line: And in 1985, cold weather moved Reagan's inaugural parade to Epcot, with Mickey himself.
